column4: The statistics arrow remains visible and clickable after ten genuine runs; demo access keeps the earlier guidance.
About now has six compact information buttons with separate popups and shows the installed version and build.
News now uses dated article cards, while Changes uses build navigation and clickable sprite entries.
Historical builds with missing evidence are explicitly marked incomplete instead of receiving guessed change notes.
UIMSD Home uses compact native controls, aligned statistics and optional explanations; tap wins, deaths or abandoned runs to explore matching records.
I added compact information screens and refreshed statistics Home. Missing historical evidence remains clearly marked.
